C_same is not computed on any day: the bundle carries the exogenous inputs at decision time for the replay half's single day only, and the tree has no measured-house plant other than the learned model the oracle excludes. findings.title: Solver self-test counts every restart's not-run publish as a 0 ms solve
findings.claim: On the real bundle, debugger._solver_smoke's week_solve_ms spread admits 10 rows whose payload was the not-run publish (no action, solve_time_ms 0), so the self-test reports min 0 ms and n 662 where 652 solves ran.
findings.mechanism: _apply_unsolved_payload publishes solve_time_ms 0 for a solve that never ran (the light first refresh after each restart); cycle_row copies it into payload_solve_time_ms and _solver_smoke spreads every row carrying the key.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, load1 about 22; a count

perturbation.change: --perturb solver-filter: _solver_smoke's spread drops a row whose payload_solve_time_ms is 0 (in memory)

findings.metric_definition: Rows the solver self-test's week_solve_ms spread admits whose payload carried no action and solve_time_ms 0 (n_spread minus rows with a positive solve time).
findings.phenomenon_property: A solve-time statistic over published payloads ranges only over payloads where a solve ran; the not-run payload's inert 0 is never read as a duration.

null_control.note: no restart in the synthetic week

findings.proposed_fix_scope: debugger._solver_smoke (or cycle_row omitting the key when optimization_status is not_run), one line and a test row.

findings.title: dbg_bundle_gen's null-control rows are a diverged copy of cycle_row; feed self-test raises on them
findings.claim: Every row tools/replay/dbg_bundle_gen.py writes differs from debugger.cycle_row's row for the same payload (48 of 48 in one day), and debugger.feed_health raises TypeError on them, so D15's mandated null control cannot run M7's self-test re-derivation.
findings.mechanism: build_bundle.recording_tick builds its row with its own dict literal: keeps None-valued keys (production drops them), no version, no t on the accuracy sample, no manifest self_tests.

perturbation.change: --perturb production-row: row = debugger.cycle_row(self, data, dt_util.now(), wall_ms) in build_bundle's source, in memory

findings.metric_definition: Rows of one generated day whose keys or values differ from cycle_row's row for the same coordinator and payload at the same tick (solve_wall_ms by presence).
findings.phenomenon_property: The null-control bundle is produced by the production collector's own functions, so every reader of a real bundle runs unchanged on the synthetic one.

null_control.note: production rows for the same payloads read cleanly

findings.proposed_fix_scope: dbg_bundle_gen builds rows, snapshots and self_tests through debugger's functions; a gate_checks arm runs feed_health and sensor_sanity on a generated row.

findings.title: debug_replay seeds unmasked entity ids into a masked replay; learned heat-loss learners reset
findings.claim: On the owner's bundle, debug_replay.seed_stores writes 4 store-held entity ids that name no entity of the masked replay half; over the 18-cycle window the replayed coordinator voids 2 learned heat-loss learners ('its zone sensor changed') and warns 1 input unreadable, and remapping the ids through the mask brings both counts to 0.
findings.mechanism: seed_stores remaps the store key onto test_entry but copies each document verbatim; thermal_learning's zone entities, dhw_legionella, off_restore and snapshots keep the install's real ids while the replay config holds masked ones, so _void_heat_loss_learners resets house_heat_loss_scale and lower_floor_loss_ratio and every M5/M8 reproduction plans on configuration defaults; the five replay judges stay 0, so the lane's verdict does not show it.

evidence.contention_note: three arms in parallel beside other seats, load1 55-280; counts

perturbation.change: --perturb remap-ids: store-held ids rewritten to the masked id of the same configuration key before seeding
perturbation.observed_value: 0 foreign ids, 0 learner resets, 0 unreadable warnings

findings.metric_definition: Over the replay window: WARNING records voiding a learned heat-loss learner because its zone sensor changed, beside the count of seeded ids absent from the masked replay half.
findings.phenomenon_property: A replay seeded from a bundle's stores names only entities of the replay half it runs on, and starts from the learned state the install held.
findings.seam_rule: grep -n "entity_id\|_entities" custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/off_restore.py custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/legionella.py custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/snapshots.py custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py (every store document seed_stores copies, store.DOMAINS)

findings.proposed_fix_scope: debug_replay.seed_stores maps every entity id in a seeded document through the replay half's mask (pairs from the replay entry's configuration keys), or refuses an id outside it; a gate_checks arm proves no learner is voided.

leads.what: On the owner's bundle the 3-interval rule finds 2 restart gaps while the not-run first publish (row with no action_mode and payload_solve_time_ms 0) marks 10 restarts, 8 of them upgrades with gaps of 2-28 min; M1's attribution by gap would miss them (rows here carry version, so attribution is unaffected this round).

The stores self-test re-derives 82 off-domain paths at baseline: off_restore armed/* is declared real but written as an {entity_id, value} dict, so the domain never checks the restored value; snapshots hold pre-rename learners/thermal_learning/cop_baseline and cop_health_cusum (80 paths); thermal_learning capacity_envelope/*/1 is below its declared minimum 1 in one entry.

Stores are seeded from the download instant, 1-2 days after the replay window: the ledger, pump_duty and duty_switch stamps are bounded as 'ahead of the clock', and learned state from after the window enters the timeline replay.

Over the week's distinct accuracy samples, planned power exceeds measured by interval kind: hot_water 1.66 vs 0.72 kW mean (127 samples), user boost 4.94 vs 2.39 (102), pre_heat 3.07 vs 1.15 (11), eco 1.55 vs 1.46 (81); the per-day cost model gap is 10-187 percent (m9_costs.py).

For a live bundle, C_same has no measured-house plant other than the learned model the oracle excludes, and exogenous inputs at decision time exist only for the replay half's day; D15.M9 cannot be completed until the method names that plant.
On the owner's host the tile solve doubles the cycle's wall (median 19 s over the payload solve on 7.1.x); at baseline 0.667 extra solves per scheduled solve (solves_per_cycle axis).
